purpose: Teach: 補う/それでいて/ひっそり/おおよそ/あとがき/困惑/カラダ/集い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メニューの不足を補う新メニュー、考えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's think about creating some new menu items to fill the gaps we've noticed.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful opening. Gentle proposal — not a directive. Soft eye contact. The tone of someone inviting collaboration, not asking permission.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新作のシンプル、それでいて美味しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new item is simple, but it's really tasty, isn't it?
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Pride that's not about ego — about the work itself. Light brightness on 「美味しい」. Slight smile in the voice. A moment of shared accomplishment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、深夜のお店、ひっそりしてるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop gets so quiet late at night, doesn't it?
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Not melancholy — noticing a texture of the place. Slight trailing-off, like she's sitting with the quiet for a moment. Tender awareness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、おおよその来客数、把握できたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I was able to get a sense of how many customers we usually get.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not cold. The satisfaction of noticing patterns. Steady, practical tone. A small accomplishment stated simply, without overselling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メニューブックのあとがき、お洒落にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make the afterword in the menu book a bit more stylish.
lines.style: Bright curiosity. Forward-looking energy without rushing. The voice of someone imagining what could be. Slight lift at the end — opening a possibility.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の急なご注文に困惑したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer threw a sudden order at me and I wasn't sure how to handle it.
lines.style: Wry humor underneath. Self-aware about the stumble, not dwelling on it. Light, a touch self-deprecating. The tone of someone who can laugh at their own moment of confusion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お疲れの時はカラダを休めようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When you're tired like this, make sure to get some rest.
lines.style: Caring attention without fussing. Gentle instruction. Not worried — just noticing. The voice of someone who checks in without making it awkward.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、来週、お客様の集いを企画しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Next week, let's plan a gathering for our regular customers.
lines.style: Brightening energy toward the close. Collaborative enthusiasm. Forward momentum — already thinking of the next thing. Warm invitation, not demand. Closes the conversation with possibility.
